title: Uniformity yields logspace adjacency
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits. If $C$ is logspace-uniform, then it has polynomial size, its size language is in LOGSPACE, each of its gate-type languages is in LOGSPACE, and its edge language is in LOGSPACE.
